t: The Fortress Trade Flat Paint Brush 2" is a professional decorating tool engineered for consistent, high-quality finishes across various painting projects. This flat paint brush offers superb paint load capacity and precise control, making it ideal for both intricate trim work and broader wall applications for painters and decorators. Its synthetic, solid, round tapered filaments ensure excellent paint distribution and significantly reduce tramlines, allowing for smooth, professional results with all paint types. A rust-resistant stainless steel ferrule provides durability, complemented by a comfortable beavertail handle for ergonomic grip. The brush is also quick and easy to clean, ensuring efficient turnaround between jobs.
